{{Youmay|the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' class|the [[Chapter 5: The Gunslinger|episode of ''The Mandalorian'']]}}
[[File:TwilekGunslinger-SWTOR.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] gunslinger]]
A '''gunslinger''' was a fast-drawing, [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]-wielding soldier of fortune.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]''</ref> Gunslingers appeared during the years of the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that followed it circa [[3653 BBY]], but could be found throughout any era, including during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and [[Legacy era]].<ref name="Legacy Era Campaign Guide">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Gunslingers were known for their phenomenal skill with [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]], making them deadly in battle.<ref name="HoloSmug">{{Holonet|classes|smuggler|Smuggler}}</ref> Some gunslingers served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], while others preferred to serve themselves. Freelancing gunslingers would hire their services out as [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]], professional duelists, or even [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]]. Notable gunslingers included [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Gallandro/Legends|Gallandro]], and [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]].<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" />

{{Soldier-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The gunslinger is an advanced class for the smuggler class in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' MMO video game. This advanced class specializes in dual [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] pistols, trick shots, and utlizing cover in combat.<ref name="HoloSmug" /> The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] counterpart for this archetype is the [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]].<ref name="TORweb-STAR WARS: The Old Republic Fan Friday August 20, 2010">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20100820-0|text=STAR WARS: The Old Republic Fan Friday (August 20, 2010)|nolive=1}}</ref>
